title: swelter surface payload
description: The Python↔JS contract for `/api/surface.json` and `web/sample-surface.json` — the aggregated, gridded heat/AQI surface the dashboard reads. Emitted by `cli._write_web_sample` / `server.py` (src/swelter/aggregate.py `CellReading.as_record`); consumed by `web/app.js` `setData()`. A deliberate field change on either side must edit this schema and both validating tests in the same PR (FIX-07).

uncertainty_note.description: Why this cell publishes no numeric `uncertainty`, when there is a reason to carry: which axis bounds an `exposure` level, how many calibrated member 1-sigmas were unknown, or that a NowCast record blends unevenly-weighted hours. Absent on a cell that simply has a number. A null `uncertainty` is never a claim that there is nothing to report (ADR 0035).

history_context.description: Where this hour's value sits in this same cell's own recorded distribution for the same calendar month (#241) — the network's own record, never an external climatology or a model. `null` whenever no percentile may be published honestly, and then `history_context_reason` carries the code and the sentence. Both keys are always written, so one shape reads the same everywhere.

basis.description: `raw` means the baseline is not calibrated-only — the reading is provisional, or too few calibrated hours are recorded — and must be rendered as provisional wherever it is shown.

history_context_reason.description: Why there is no `history_context`, when there is none. Three codes rather than one, because only `thin_history` is resolved by recording more hours: `ordinal_layer` is the derived `exposure` tier, which is not a measured quantity, and `single_window_reading` is the one NowCast reading derived per cell, which has no recorded distribution to sit in.
